data.gender_notes: Hodges is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘hod’ meaning ‘god’ and ‘gast’ meaning ‘healer’ or ‘guest’. The name Hodges was used for a person believed to be favored by God and called upon to heal or provide hospitality. The name Hodges carries the meaning “God's healer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hodges usually hope their child will grow to embody god's healer and live with faith, good character and purpose.

For many generations, the name Hodges was cherished within families as a symbol of illustrious heritage and strong character.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Hodges can be seen as a personal reminder of the importance of both healing and hospitality. For Christians, the name Hodges could signify a call to emulate the compassionate nature of God by offering healing and comfort to those in need, as well as providing a warm and welcoming environment to strangers and fellow believers. Ultimately, the name Hodges can serve as a daily inspiration to live a life that honors God, while also striving to be a source of restoration and sanctuary to others.
